general.title: Events
general.description: Manage meets, parts fairs and trade shows

list.duplicateHint: Copy with date +1 year and status “Inactive” – handy for annual meets
list.duplicated: Copy created (date +1 year, inactive). Please check it and set it to “Active”.
list.deleteText: Really delete “{title}”? This cannot be undone.
list.hint: The storefront only shows active events that end today or later – past events disappear automatically. Suggestions from the “Report a meet” form are never visible until you accept them; suggestions that are not accepted are deleted after 180 days.
list.loadError: The events could not be loaded.
list.saveError: The event could not be saved.
list.deleteError: The event could not be deleted.

detail.placeholderProgram: e.g. Sat 9 am–6 pm, Sun 9 am–4 pm
detail.helpEnd: Empty = one-day event. The event disappears from the storefront the day after it ends.
detail.helpUrl: Only addresses starting with http:// or https://. Opens as “Learn more” in a new tab.
detail.helpParticipation: With booth → section “Where you can meet us”. Without booth → “More meets in the scene”. Not yet decided → like without booth, with a note.
detail.helpStatus: Only active events are shown in the storefront. Suggestions come from the “Report a meet” form.
detail.helpChannels: Empty = show in all sales channels.
detail.helpNote: For you only, never shown in the storefront.
detail.suggestionText: This event was submitted via “Report a meet” and is not visible in the storefront. Check the details, choose the participation and click “Accept”. The reporter's email address is removed in the process.
detail.errorEnd: The end is before the start.
detail.errorUrl: Please enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

cms.areaHelp: All: both sections with headings. Otherwise only the selected section without its own heading.
cms.areaBooth: With booth (“Where you can meet us”)
cms.areaScene: Without booth (“More meets in the scene”)
cms.emptyText: Text when there are no events
cms.defaultEmptyText: The next dates will be announced soon.
cms.showReport: Show “Is your meet missing?” with the “Report a meet” form
cms.reportText: Text above the “Report a meet” button
cms.defaultReportText: Is your meet missing? Let us know – we are happy to add it.
cms.previewNote: Sample data – the storefront shows the events you maintain (Content → Events).
